gaps.sentence: She always gets round ___ washing up by promising to do it later.
gaps.explanation: get round to = finally find time for; here: avoid a duty — test the preposition after get round.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The doctors pulled him ___ after a difficult night.
gaps.explanation: pull through = recover from a serious illness.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.
